package.description: The simple command-line tool to find if the file is a 32-bit or 64-bit Executable. You can specify any valid PE file like EXE, DLL, OCX etc.

en-US.description: The simple command-line tool to find if the file is a 32-bit or 64-bit Executable. You can specify any valid PE file like EXE, DLL, OCX etc.
en-US.longDescription: The simple command-line tool to find if the file is a 32-bit or 64-bit Executable. You can specify any valid PE file like EXE, DLL, OCX etc. Note that as of v2.1, it does not distinguish between traditional and ARM architectures.
en-US.name: EXE 64bit Detector
